resources.name: Lifetime data for 38Ar

access.notes: CSV file containing adopted lifetimes (excitation energy, lifetime, uncertainty) for bound levels in 38Ar, provided as part of the task materials.

resources.notes: Adopted mean lifetimes for 37 bound levels below 9 MeV, extracted from Table 2 of the paper.

resources.name: Branching ratios for 38Ar

access.notes: CSV file containing gamma branching ratios (initial and final level energies, spins/parities, branching fractions, uncertainties, and known mixing ratios) compiled from the literature and provided as part of the task materials.

resources.notes: Branching ratios from the Endt & van der Leun compilation (Nucl. Phys. A310, 1978) and subsequent measurements, supplemented with the paper's own data.
